research_brief.research_summary: The AI video generation market has matured rapidly from novelty demos to production-grade tools, with Sora, Veo 3, Kling, and Runway Gen-4 competing on quality and cost. The single most important insight is that subscription-based access (Google Flow, HeyGen plans) is now significantly more cost-effective than per-call API pricing for moderate-to-high production volumes, changing the economics of AI video production entirely.

misconceptions.myth: You need a powerful GPU to use AI video generation
misconceptions.reality: All major commercial providers (Kling, Runway, Veo, HeyGen) are cloud API-based and need only an internet connection and API key

misconceptions.myth: More expensive tools always produce better output
misconceptions.reality: Different tools excel at different visual styles — Kling leads on cinematic fidelity, MiniMax on prompt-following, Pexels/Pixabay stock is often indistinguishable for wide establishing shots

audience_insights.knowledge_level: Audience is likely familiar with basic AI tools (ChatGPT, image generators) but new to video-specific AI. They know that AI video exists but underestimate how production-ready it is.
